konu: Universal Declaration of Human Rights, Supporting Disadvantaged People & Human Rights Mottos
ciktilar: İnsan Hakları Evrensel Beyannamesi'nin (UDHR) tarihsel gelişimini ve temel maddelerini İngilizce kavramlarla açıklar.
Dezavantajlı bireylerin karşılaştığı sorunlara yönelik empatik bir dille İngilizce çözüm önerileri sunar.
İnsan hakları, eşitlik, onur ve toplumsal dayanışma temalı İngilizce özdeyişleri (mottos) ve metinleri analiz eder.
hatirla: Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR), Eleanor Roosevelt başkanlığında hazırlanmış ve 10 Aralık 1948'de BM tarafından kabul edilmiştir.
Temel insan hakları devredilemezdir (inalienable); 'deprive of' (mahrum bırakmak), 'stand up for' (savunmak) ve 'dignity' (onur) anahtar kavramlardır.
Dezavantajlı bireyler için erişilebilirlik (accessibility: wheelchair ramps, Braille books, tactile pavements) ve empatik dil (people with disabilities) esastır.

sorular.soru: Match the core human rights vocabulary with their English definitions.
ciftler: The state or quality of being worthy of honour and respect (Onur)
Unable to be taken away from or given away by the possessor (Devredilemez)
Unfair treatment of people based on race, gender or disability (Ayrımcılık)

sorular.soru: Choose the best option: "Conscientious citizens always _______ justice and defend the fundamental rights of vulnerable groups."
sorular.cozum: 'Stand up for' bir hakkı, adaleti veya dezavantajlı bireyleri cesaretle savunmak ve desteklemek anlamına gelir; 'look down on' ise küçümsemek demektir.

sorular.soru: What is the main message of Article 1 of the UDHR: "All human beings are born free and equal in dignity and rights"?
sorular.cevap: Freedom, human dignity and basic rights are not privileges granted later.

sorular.soru: Read the statements about Human Rights and write D (True) or Y (False).

ifadeler.metin: The Universal Declaration of Human Rights was adopted by the UN on December 10, 1948.
Eleanor Roosevelt chaired the UN commission that drafted the declaration of 30 articles.
The word 'prejudice' means treating everyone fairly and equally without any bias.
In English grammar, the verb 'deprive' is followed by the preposition 'from' (deprive from).

sorular.soru: Complete the table with practical urban and educational solutions for disadvantaged groups.
satirlar: Difficulty reading printed signs and navigating streets

satirlar.b: Providing Braille books, audiobooks and tactile pavements

satirlar: Inaccessible public buildings, stairs and buses

satirlar.b: Installing wheelchair ramps, elevators and accessible transport

satirlar: Barriers in verbal communication and announcements

satirlar.b: Employing sign language interpreters and visual subtitles
Granting equal educational scholarships and language support

sorular.soru: Put the steps of organizing a school human rights awareness campaign into the logical order.
ogeler: Identifying the needs of disadvantaged people in the local community
Crafting an inspiring motto such as 'Respect differences, embrace diversity!'
Designing accessible posters and inviting volunteers to the charity event
Providing scholarships and assistive materials with the collected funds

sorular.soru: Which of the following mottos best expresses combating discrimination and valuing cultural diversity?
secenekler: "Respect differences, embrace diversity, unite for equality!"
"Silence your voice when you witness an unfair treatment!"
"Ignore global problems and focus only on yourself!"
sorular.cozum: 'Respect differences, embrace diversity, unite for equality!' özdeyişi emir kipi ve paralel yapıyla farklılıklara saygıyı ve eşitliği vurgular.

sorular.soru: Fill in the blanks with the words from the box.

cumleler.metin: All human beings are born free and equal in ___ and rights.
No child should be deprived ___ the right to quality education.
Books printed in the ___ alphabet help visually impaired people read by touch.

sorular.soru: Match the English words from the Human Rights unit with their synonyms.
Evaluate the statements on inclusive language and mottos as D (True) or Y (False).

ifadeler.metin: Using person-first language like 'people with disabilities' is respectful and inclusive.
Human rights mottos often use imperative verbs and parallel structures to be memorable.
The motto 'No one is free until everyone is free' supports social inequality.
Tactile pavements are textured ground surfaces that guide visually impaired pedestrians.

sorular.soru: Find the English words from the clues and discover the key word.

satirlar.ipucu: Fair treatment and behaviour according to the law (7 letters: J _ _ _ _ _ _)
The state of being worthy of honour and self-respect (7 letters: D _ _ _ _ _ _)
A short, striking sentence expressing a guiding principle (5 letters: M _ _ _ _)

sorular.soru: Explain the meaning of the motto "Injustice anywhere is a threat to justice everywhere" and write one suggestion for youth.
sorular.cevap: Human rights are interconnected. a violation in one place endangers justice for all.
